implementation_notes.note: **Page Layout:** Simplified structure - no tab navigation. Main components are PositioningSummary (consolidated panel) and HoldingsTab (holdings view).
**Data Fetching:** Uses React Query for caching with 5-10 minute stale times and 10-30 minute garbage collection. Automatic retry and refetch on window focus.
**Portfolio Configuration:** 5 model portfolios (UST, ST, INT, LTC, LTA) plus AGG aggregate, each with canonical hex colors defined in multiple files.
**Data Sources:** All data comes from S3-backed JSON files served through API Gateway CloudFront cache. DEMO mode uses public endpoints; production mode requires JWT Bearer token auth.
**Attribution Analysis:** Supports hierarchical breakdown: Asset Class > Segment > ETF Holding with metrics for weights, returns, and attribution effects.
**Grid Alignment:** PORTFOLIO_GRID_TEMPLATE ensures perfect vertical alignment between allocation bars and matrix table using shared config.
**Color System:** Fixed Income = #10b981 (green-500), Equity = #3b82f6 (blue-500), Hedge = #a855f7 (purple), with segment-specific shades for hierarchy visualization.
**Duration Proxy:** Equity holdings use 20-year modified duration proxy for unified duration measurement across asset classes.
